scope: Existing cylindrical WAXS source-grid operator fixture with a curved complete-orbit detector. Effective single-carbon channel, q-dependent Waasmaier-Kirfel f0 and its derivative. No measured atomic-library refinement or detector-integrated counts.
geometry: rho=tan(theta_nom), theta_nom=0.025..1 rad; detector height z=D+kappa*rho^2, k=8 nm^-1. Common support envelope qp<=8, padding48, margin64, radii0..1.5nm, zsource -1.5..1.5nm.
objective: Fixed masked weighted squared residual of point intensities, normalized by sum(weight*target^2). Target is synthetic positive random data independent of tested forward; no recovery experiment. Both parameter derivatives include form-factor chain rule.
confirmation: After pilot, five fresh CUDA processes on largest case, randomized method order; synchronized timing. Each process is one paired sample, hot calls only estimate time. Same input, q geometry, support and tolerance for all methods.
fairness: Production comparator uses current fused custom backward with object gradients disabled. coordinate_fields already shares Miller and axial contraction. tangent_full and tangent_stream change the direction/placement of derivative synthesis and loss reduction. No forced unrelated adjoint and no dense Jacobian baseline.
memory: Incremental max_memory_allocated measured for one synchronized call after warmup; not total GPU process memory. Sources may change between calls, no cross-call source FFT cache in any arm. Preparation/JIT excluded from hot results and recorded separately.
limits: No GPU instruction-level Miller/contraction fusion, no automatic cutoff differentiation, arbitrary detector tilt, multi-element atomic library or optimizer speed claim. Existing 20260903 fused-pullback results retained without rerun.
